title: Sparkplug SDK Onramp Micro-assets: Auth, Key Rotation, Streaming & Toolcall Variants
creator: Luca Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable visual asset kit for the SDK/API onboarding docs that demonstrates authentication flows, managed key rotation, streaming responses, and tool-calling patterns. Deliverables should be optimized for docs (PNG + SVG), in-page micro GIFs for streaming and toolcall animations, and annotated code-snippet overlays that can be dropped into the quickstart. Assets should be theme-aware (light/dark) and follow the design token palette and spacing system used by the developer docs. This ticket covers asset design, Figma components, export spec, and handoff to Docs and Engineering for integration.
acceptance_criteria: SVG and 2x PNG exports for all illustrations and micro-interactions (auth flow, key rotation, streaming indicator, toolcall handshake)
Animated micro-GIFs (max 2s loop) for streaming token flow and toolcall interaction, optimized for web docs under 150KB each
Figma component library with tokens mapped to console-2026.03 palette and exported spec for engineers
Annotated code snippet overlays for JS, Python, and curl that align visually with the docs code block styles
Docs team confirms in-situ integration in the quickstart page and no visual regressions in dark mode

notes: We intentionally chose a simplified visual language to keep file sizes small and to reduce cognitive load for first-time SDK users. Trade-off: hero illustrations will be less detailed; compensated by annotated overlays and short microcopy. If GIF size constraints become blocking, pursue Lottie/web-animated SVG as next step.
